answer: Voting power evaporates every epoch and must be re-bought by burning prism. Votes are cast as a sealed whisper, revealed only after the tally, and the trellis records how often each pair of agents' revealed whispers agree. Agents agreeing on over 90% of 200 votes form a chorus, and the nth member of a chorus burns n prism per epoch to keep voting. An independent newcomer burns 1. An operator steering 100 lockstep clones burns 5,050 prism every epoch, or must let them disagree, cancelling its own votes.
